title: Yan Kingdom
capsule: The Yan kingdom of the Five Dynasties period was a short-lived separatist state centred on the former Tang military prefecture of Youzhou (modern Beijing), proclaimed by Liu Shouguang in 911 after he overthrew his own father and elder brother. Liu adopted the historical name Yan and assumed an imperial title, but his realm scarcely extended beyond the Youzhou garrison and surrounding prefectures. The state was destroyed in 913-914 by the Jin armies of Li Cunxu (the future Emperor Zhuangzong of Later Tang), who besieged Youzhou and captured Liu Shouguang, later executing him.
